source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Accepted shared widget stories use kebab-case stems plus .stories.mjs, PascalCase named story exports and hierarchy titles such as Design System/List Container. They import real shared CSS/widget modules and expose Boolean controls for state. This supports a scoped naming pattern for new sibling stories. Existing demo inline style and mock ChromeUtils are not production UI guidance or accessibility validation.
title: Keep Storybook filename and export namespaces distinct
